relation: Exact RAW support on SUPPLIED data, pattern before host: x is model-supported by br : H -> G and ep : H -> H -> seq G when x = br h for some pattern vertex h, or x occurs in ep u v for some genuine pattern edge u -- v. Both orientations contribute; lists on non-edges are ignored; the empty pattern supports nothing; an edgeless pattern supports exactly the image of br. No injectivity, path, simplicity, inducedness, reversal or disjointness condition. X98/X114 read it on full edge paths and Minor sdm_covers on subdivision interiors (discharged Section arguments K H m kept); the surrounding Records are not identified.
summary: C19 migrates exactly three raw-support sources onto GTBase.model_support.model_support: X98 and X114 model_vertex and the public Minor sdm_covers, whose discharged Section arguments K H m are kept. The canonical is a raw disjunction on supplied data, pattern before host: a branch image, or a member of a supplied list on a genuine pattern edge, in either orientation. It asks for no injectivity, path, inducedness, reversal or disjointness.

Sixteen current objects (3 sources, 9 chains including two seven-field Records and the X114 decision problem, 4 complete rows) carry whole iff or two-way transport certificates. Three complete Originals compose earlier frozen histories: X98 with B3 path helpers and A5 x59_subgraph_of, X114 with B3 path helpers and A14 x114_subcubic, X220 theta/prism with B4 even-wheel chain. Every older body stays verbatim; five older snapshots that keep this family live names are documented.

The public-only client covers branch images, genuine edge lists in both orientations, a constant branch map with a non-path list, the empty pattern, an edgeless pattern, ignored non-edge lists and empty lists. Interior-list subdivision models and full-path induced Records are not identified.
